description:
The `not` half of the §42.3.5 worked example: with @user still `not`, `${ given @user :> {

…

} }` renders nothing and a click on a handler whose body is `given @user :> { … }` leaves @msg untouched — no runtime fault. Pre-s461 impl#1 threw ReferenceError on the undeclared bare name `user` (at load, and on click).
rationale: §42.2.3: "Multi-narrowing is all-or-nothing. If any listed variable is `not`, the body is skipped entirely." (the single-variable case is the one-element list). §42.1: `not` propagates, it does not fault.
